You are a programming expert.

Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From c79484f68b164a4b59c85b7a5008455ddd7af6fb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2020 15:13:37 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/mediatek: Fix Kconfig warning

WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for MTK_MMSYS
  Depends on [n]: (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK_MT8173_MMSYS [=n]
  Selected by [y]:
  - DRM_MEDIATEK [=y] && HAS_IOMEM [=y] && DRM [=y] && (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || ARM && COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK [=y] && HAVE_ARM_SMCCC [=y] && OF [=y]

Make DRM_MEDIATEK depend on MTK_MMSYS to fix this.

Fixes: 2c758e301ed9 ("soc / drm: mediatek: Move routing control to mmsys device")
Signed-off-by: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Enric Balletbo i Serra <enric.balletbo@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
index c420f5a3d33b..aa74aac3cbcc 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig
@@ -6,12 +6,12 @@ config DRM_MEDIATEK
 	depends on COMMON_CLK
 	depends on HAVE_ARM_SMCCC
 	depends on OF
+	depends on MTK_MMSYS
 	select DRM_GEM_CMA_HELPER
 	select DRM_KMS_HELPER
 	select DRM_MIPI_DSI
 	select DRM_PANEL
 	select MEMORY
-	select MTK_MMSYS
 	select MTK_SMI
 	select VIDEOMODE_HELPERS
 	help
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/mediatek/Kconfig`**
   - The line `select MTK_MMSYS` has been changed to `depends on MTK_MMSYS`. This modification alters the relationship of the `DRM_MEDIATEK` configuration option with `MTK_MMSYS`, making it a dependency rather than a selection.

### Relationships

- The change establishes that `DRM_MEDIATEK` now requires `MTK_MMSYS` to be enabled for it to be configured, addressing the unmet direct dependencies warning. This ensures that the configuration is more logically consistent, as `DRM_MEDIATEK` relies on `MTK_MMSYS` being present, rather than just selecting it without ensuring its availability. This fix is related to a previous commit that moved routing control to the `mmsys` device, indicating that the dependency was overlooked in that change.

2. explain how the bug is fixed, including code statements fixing the bug and why. 

You must include one or more code statements in point 1 and 2.
Code statements included in point 1 should be as brief as possible, only include the ones that are most related to the root cause and  the number of code statements may not exceed 3.


Here is the commit message:
drm/mediatek: Fix Kconfig warning

WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for MTK_MMSYS
  Depends on [n]: (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK_MT8173_MMSYS [=n]
  Selected by [y]:
  - DRM_MEDIATEK [=y] && HAS_IOMEM [=y] && DRM [=y] && (ARCH_MEDIATEK [=y] || ARM && COMPILE_TEST [=n]) && COMMON_CLK [=y] && HAVE_ARM_SMCCC [=y] && OF [=y]

Make DRM_MEDIATEK depend on MTK_MMSYS to fix this.

Fixes: 2c758e301ed9 ("soc / drm: mediatek: Move routing control to mmsys device")
Signed-off-by: YueHaibing <yuehaibing@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Enric Balletbo i Serra <enric.balletbo@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Chun-Kuang Hu <chunkuang.hu@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an unmet direct dependency for the `MTK_MMSYS` configuration option, which was incorrectly set to be selected by `DRM_MEDIATEK` instead of being a required dependency. This oversight led to potential configuration issues when building the driver, as `MTK_MMSYS` may not have been enabled, resulting in warnings during the Kconfig processing.

Here is the patch:
 	depends on HAVE_ARM_SMCCC
 	depends on OF
+	depends on MTK_MMSYS
 	select DRM_GEM_CMA_HELPER
 	select DRM_KMS_HELPER
 	select DRM_PANEL
 	select MEMORY
-	select MTK_MMSYS
 	select MTK_SMI
 	select VIDEOMODE_HELPERS

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext
- select MTK_MMSYS
```
Reason:
The `MTK_MMSYS` configuration option was incorrectly set to be selected by `DRM_MEDIATEK`, which means that it would only be enabled if `DRM_MEDIATEK` was selected. This created an unmet dependency situation because `MTK_MMSYS` might not be enabled when required, leading to warnings during Kconfig processing.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
+ depends on MTK_MMSYS
```
Reason:
By changing the configuration from `select MTK_MMSYS` to `depends on MTK_MMSYS`, it ensures that `DRM_MEDIATEK` will only be enabled if `MTK_MMSYS` is also enabled, thus resolving the unmet dependency issue and preventing warnings during the Kconfig processing.
